releaseNotes:
💌 Wishes now have two versions, for past customers and for people who enquired
📋 Upcoming occasions shows who's who, with a filter
features: NEW: Separate wish messages for past customers and for people who only enquired
NEW: Upcoming occasions marks PAST CUSTOMER / ENQUIRED and filters by either
IMPROVED: Wish cards are timing-neutral (no date, no "Happy…")
bugFixes: Lost-enquiry wishes no longer read as if we decorated their event
Wish card no longer implies the occasion is today
